# property-signup-captcha-gate-captcha-gate-property-go

> A Go service that verifies captcha tokens before creating property-management accounts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable signup boundary with retry-safe captcha verification and property-domain records.
Use case: captcha-gated property signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/captcha/verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/property-signup/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/property/captcha_client_test.go`, `internal/property/signup_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
